## Dependencies and scope

The imported principle links resolve within this subset. `typescript-best-practices` and its examples are host-neutral language guidance, loaded only for TypeScript work when the mode calls for them.

The upstream `principle-prove-it-works` leaf mentions `show-me-your-work` as context for auditable work. That workflow is not imported. Use the mode's local continuity and verification-record guidance for that concern; do not claim the upstream workflow is installed.

No imported file names a model, host tool, company, tracker, or outbound write permission. The governing mode and repository instructions retain authority over these principle recommendations.
